title: glyptopetalum angulatum
intro: Glyptopetalum angulatum, commonly known as the 'Indian Tinospora', is a plant species in the family Menispermaceae. It is traditionally used in Ayurvedic medicine, valued for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which contribute to its therapeutic actions such as reducing fever and alleviating respiratory issues. Bioactive constituents present in the plant include alkaloids, glycosides, and phenolic compounds, which are believed to be responsible for its medicinal properties. The plant has been used in traditional medicine to treat various ailments, and its bioactive constituents have been studied for their potential in the development of new medicines.
